messages.author: 1004dd6f66bb10c3
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Stan meeting tomorrow?
parts:
I'm pretty sure California has sharks too. Also earthquakes, droughts,
and mudslides. And a wide variety of poisonous snakes. And mountain
lions, pumas, cougars, and catamounts (http://xkcd.com/999/). And, in
the Bay Area, an astonishingly high cost of living—what is this, New
York?

But no power grid-crippling hurricanes! Gross mismanagement, yes, but
hurricanes, no.
(http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling_blackout#California)
